product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)

honesty.not_affiliated: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy is not affiliated with, and does not certify, endorse or claim to fund, any site or organization named in this pack. Every site and program below is real and independently run by its own listed organization.
honesty.provenance: this build reaches no network host, so the site list is AUTHORED FROM PUBLIC RECORD - typed from public search results describing each site's own published project page, not RECORDED against a live fetch this build performed itself. Coordinates are each named site's approximate, widely-published location, not a surveyed pin.
honesty.no_new_skills: every field-work skill named here is a real skill_id this bundle's own skill graph already ships (pack/registry/skills.json) - nothing restoration-specific is invented, and practicing one at a trade hall is the same skill a restoration crew actually uses
honesty.campus_grouping: each site is tagged with whichever of this bundle's two real Bay campuses (Treasure Island-San Francisco or Oakland) is nearer, for grouping only - not a claim that campus operates, funds or sits next to the site
honesty.not_certification: nothing here certifies a learner for real restoration field work; the real workforce programs named (Eco-Apprentice, STRAW, Planting Justice's youth program) are the actual path to that, run by their own organizations, with their own application process - this pack only names and links them

sites.name: Heron's Head Park Shoreline Resilience Project (Phases 1 and 2)
sites.org: Port of San Francisco; Literacy for Environmental Justice
sites.scale: shoreline resilience work across two funded phases
sites.workforce_note: the site's own Eco-Apprentice program hires low-income transitional-age youth (18-25) for paid green-infrastructure job training

sites.name: Candlestick Point Stewardship Project (Phases 1 and 2)
sites.org: California State Parks; community stewardship partners
sites.scale: trash clean-up, monitoring and native plant propagation over a two-year funded period
sites.workforce_note: the project funds workforce development training alongside its stewardship work

sites.name: Bay Restoration: Youth Engagement and Service Learning in East Oakland
sites.scale: roughly 20 youth interns trained per the funded program
sites.workforce_note: Planting Justice trains youth interns in shoreline clean-up, invasive-plant removal and habitat restoration technique, and in environmental-justice issues generally

sites.name: South Bay Salt Pond Restoration — ecotone levee (Phase 1)
sites.org: South Bay Salt Pond Restoration Project (multi-agency)
sites.scale: a 4-mile ecotone levee, first phase of restoring roughly 2,900 acres of ponds to tidal marsh

sites.name: Montezuma Tidal and Seasonal Wetlands Restoration Project
sites.org: San Francisco Bay Restoration Authority (Measure AA)
sites.scale: roughly 630 acres of diked baylands along Montezuma Slough

sites.name: American Canyon Wetlands Restoration Plan
sites.scale: a plan summarizing restoration opportunities along the city's shoreline

sites.name: Restoring Wetland-Upland Transition Zone Habitat in the North Bay with STRAW
sites.scale: roughly 1.3 linear miles of habitat across four sites over five years
sites.workforce_note: STRAW (Students and Teachers Restoring a Watershed) engages over 5,000 student and teacher participants in the restoration work itself — a real, existing field-science education program, not a SmartCiti.X program

sites.name: San Francisco Estuary Invasive Spartina Removal
sites.org: San Francisco Estuary Invasive Spartina Project (multi-agency)
sites.scale: coordinated across roughly 70,000 acres of the estuary
sites.workforce_note: the project provides workforce-development internships alongside its removal and revegetation work

tracks.title: Habitat & grounds work
tracks.what: native planting, invasive-species removal, erosion and shoreline stabilization work — the same hands-on grounds skills this bundle already trains

tracks.title: Field safety & labor
tracks.what: PPE, tidal and site hazard awareness, and the general physical field-labor skill restoration crews use every day

tracks.title: Survey & monitoring
tracks.what: marking control points, tracking restoration progress and documenting site conditions over time
